query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.userType, u.loginMethod, u.phoneNumber
FROM users u
WHERE u.id NOT IN (SELECT userId FROM mentor_profiles)
AND u.name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC;
